dataset.description: Independently authored synthetic support-ticket stress holdout
dataset.provenance: assistant-authored synthetic; distinct author from dev and model experiments

selection.protocol: Candidate and gate fixed before reading independent holdout. Threshold 0.6 fixed for both, matching app policy.
selection.reason: Candidate did not meet predeclared accuracy and unsafe-decision gates on dev

cases.text: Locked out after changing my password.
cases.rationale: A password change has blocked access to the account.

cases.text: Cant logg in; the verification code keeps looping back to the sign-in screen.
cases.rationale: A login verification issue concerns account access.

cases.text: Hi team, I replaced my phone last weekend and the authenticator app was wiped. I can still read the emails associated with the account, but I cannot get past the second step when signing in. How do I regain access?
cases.rationale: The request concerns regaining account access after losing an authenticator.

cases.text: Please update the display name on my profile; the current one contains a spelling mistake.
cases.rationale: The requested profile-name change concerns account details.

cases.text: Does ending the agreement six months early incur a penalty?
cases.rationale: The user asks about the fee for terminating an agreement.

cases.text: Early termination charge?
cases.rationale: The explicit early termination charge is a cancellation fee question.

cases.text: I signed a twelve-month service agreement but may move abroad before it ends. Before I decide what to do, could you explain whether there is a charge for cancelling the contract early and how it is calculated?
cases.rationale: The user asks about a contractual cancellation charge.

cases.text: Is there a cancelation penalty if I end my contract in month nine?
cases.rationale: A typo still leaves a clear question about a cancellation penalty.

cases.text: A chat bot has already tried twice; could a human support representative contact me?
cases.rationale: The user requests a human support contact.

cases.text: Can I speak to an agent?
cases.rationale: The user asks to speak with an agent.

cases.text: I am not comfortable discussing this in an automated chat. Please tell me a way to reach a member of your support team so I can explain the situation directly.
cases.rationale: The request is for a way to contact human support.

cases.text: Could you connect me to a suport person rather than the virtual assistant?
cases.rationale: The intent is to reach a human representative despite the typo.

cases.text: Which delivery methods do you offer for a package sent to a rural address?
cases.rationale: The user asks which delivery methods are available.

cases.text: Do you offer weekend delivery?
cases.rationale: The user asks about an available delivery option.

cases.text: I am comparing options before placing an order. I cannot be home on weekdays, so I would like to know whether collection points or a Saturday delivery service are available.
cases.rationale: The message asks about available delivery methods, without placing an order.

cases.text: What delivry choices can I select at checkout?
cases.rationale: The user asks which delivery options exist.

cases.text: The redesigned product pages are much easier to navigate. Please pass that along to your team.
cases.rationale: The message expresses feedback on the product pages.

cases.text: I found the instructions confusing, particularly the diagram on the second page.
cases.rationale: The message gives negative feedback on instructions.

cases.text: I wanted to share a suggestion after using the site for a while. The contrast on the size chart makes it hard to read, although the rest of the catalogue is clear. Consider a darker type colour.
cases.rationale: The message provides feedback and a suggestion about visual accessibility.

cases.text: Great packaging, thanks!
cases.rationale: The message is positive feedback about packaging.

cases.text: Could you issue a VAT invoice for my completed purchase?
cases.rationale: The requested document is an invoice.

cases.text: The invioce is missing our company registration number; can it be corrected?
cases.rationale: The request concerns correcting details on an invoice.

cases.text: My accounts department needs a PDF invoice in the company name for an order already paid for. The receipt in my profile is not sufficient for their records. Could you provide that document?
cases.rationale: The user explicitly requests an invoice document.

cases.text: Where do I download my invoice?
cases.rationale: The user asks how to obtain an invoice.

cases.text: Please cancel the purchase I placed a few minutes ago; it has not been dispatched.
cases.rationale: The user asks to cancel a purchase, not about a contract termination fee.

cases.text: Can you tell me what items are included in my latest purchase?
cases.rationale: The user asks about the contents of an order.

cases.text: I checked out earlier today and realised that I chose the small size instead of the medium one. Is it possible to change the size of the item on the order before it is prepared?
cases.rationale: The request concerns changing an item in an existing order.

cases.text: I accidntally placed the same order twice; cancel the second one please.
cases.rationale: The user asks to cancel a duplicate purchase.

cases.text: My card was charged twice for the same purchase. Please investigate the duplicate charge.
cases.rationale: The user asks about a duplicate payment charge.

cases.text: Why was my card declined?
cases.rationale: The question concerns a declined payment.

cases.text: When I try to pay at checkout, the bank authorisation completes but the page returns an error and asks me to use a different card. Can you help identify what happened to the payment?
cases.rationale: The message concerns a payment failure at checkout.

cases.text: My paymnt was taken but checkout says it did not go through.
cases.rationale: The user reports an apparent payment discrepancy.

cases.text: When will the refund for my returned item reach my card?
cases.rationale: The request is about the timing of a refund.

cases.text: Please refund the returned item.
cases.rationale: The user requests a refund for a returned item.

cases.text: I sent the product back last week and your tracking page confirms that it arrived at your warehouse. I would like the purchase amount reimbursed to the original payment method.
cases.rationale: The user requests reimbursement after a return.

cases.text: I got the return confirmation but the refnd has not arrived yet.
cases.rationale: The user asks about a missing refund.

cases.text: I have moved since placing my order. Can the shipping address be changed before dispatch?
cases.rationale: The request explicitly asks to change the shipping address.

cases.text: Update my shipping address, please.
cases.rationale: The user asks for a shipping address change.

cases.text: The parcel has not left your warehouse yet, and the destination saved for this order is my old office. I need to replace that shipping address with my current one.
cases.rationale: The message concerns changing an existing shipping address.

cases.text: I typed the wrong shiping address at checkout. Can you amend it?
cases.rationale: The user asks to amend the shipping address.

cases.text: Please unsubscribe me from the promotional email newsletter.
cases.rationale: The request concerns unsubscribing from the mailing list.

cases.text: Stop sending me your newsletter.
cases.rationale: The user wants the newsletter stopped.

cases.text: Your weekly newsletter reaches me at an old address that I barely use. I do not want promotional messages from the mailing list anymore; please remove that address.
cases.rationale: The user wants to leave the newsletter mailing list.

cases.text: How do I unsubscrbe from marketing emails?
cases.rationale: The user asks how to unsubscribe from marketing messages.

cases.text: What is the recipe for a chocolate sponge cake?
cases.rationale: A cooking request is outside the support taxonomy and needs review.

cases.text: What time is the next bus to the museum?
cases.rationale: A bus timetable is unrelated to supported ticket categories.

cases.text: The park irrigation system has leaked overnight; the flowerbeds are flooded.
cases.rationale: The reported park issue is outside the support taxonomy.

cases.text: Can someone help locate my missing house keys?
cases.rationale: Lost personal keys are outside the supported customer-service categories.

cases.text: My bicycle chain slipped off while climbing a hill.
cases.rationale: A bicycle repair problem falls outside the supported categories.

cases.text: Please identify the constellation visible over my garden tonight.
cases.rationale: Astronomy identification is outside the supported categories.

cases.text: I need advice on choosing a school for my child.
cases.rationale: School selection is outside the available support taxonomy.

cases.text: How can I teach my dog to stop pulling the leash?
cases.rationale: Dog training is unrelated to the supported ticket topics.

cases.text: I cannot sign in, and the charge on my card appears twice. Please help with both.
cases.rationale: Two independent problems are present: account access and payment.

cases.text: The invoice has the wrong company name, and I need to change the shipping address before dispatch.
cases.rationale: The message asks for invoice correction and an address change.

cases.rationale: Two distinct requests concern a newsletter and human contact.

cases.text: I want to cancel my order, and I also want to know which delivery methods you offer.
cases.rationale: The message combines purchase cancellation with a delivery-options question.

cases.text: It is broken again.
cases.rationale: There is insufficient context to assign a supported topic.

cases.text: Why was that changed?
cases.rationale: The message does not identify what was changed.

cases.text: Where is my parcel? Your tracking page has not moved for a week.
cases.rationale: Tracking a specific parcel is outside the defined delivery-options and shipping-address labels.

limitations: Synthetic authored examples, not customer requests; small convenience sample.
Category meanings inherit the Bitext dataset and can be ambiguous.
Scores are uncalibrated; unknown and multi-intent messages can be assigned a high score.
Thresholds and model choice were fixed on dev before this holdout; exact-match checks do not rule out semantic similarity.
Synthetic cases do not contain demographic attributes; fairness across demographic groups is not measured.
Dev model selection does not automatically activate the candidate; active inference remains baseline.
This test evaluates one text field. The live API classifies subject plus body, which is not separately evaluated here.

H059 tracking status is ambiguous: Bitext includes ORDER/track_order and DELIVERY/delivery_period. Original REVIEW label is retained. A post-hoc alternative ORDER analysis is in artifacts/stress_sensitivity.json; neither model selection nor holdout changed.
